examples.text: In reality, most people expect much less.
examples.translation: 事实上，大多数人的期待远没有那么高。
examples.speechText: In reality, most people expect much less.

examples.text: Preventive measures like washing your hands often can significantly lower your odds of getting sick.
examples.translation: 经常洗手等预防措施，能够显著降低生病的可能性。
examples.speechText: Preventive measures like washing your hands often can significantly lower your odds of getting sick.

examples.text: But the benefits go beyond flexibility.
examples.translation: 但好处远不止提高灵活性。
examples.speechText: But the benefits go beyond flexibility.

examples.text: Typically, an interview is held in a conference room or office.
examples.translation: 面试通常在会议室或办公室举行。
examples.speechText: Typically, an interview is held in a conference room or office.

examples.text: Learn about its history, founder, main markets and future goals.
examples.translation: 了解它的历史、创始人、主要市场和未来目标。
examples.speechText: Learn about its history, founder, main markets and future goals.

examples.text: Still, they have earned the support of important safety advocates, including Jonathan Adkins, the chief executive officer of the Governors Highway Safety Association.
examples.translation: 不过，它们已经获得了一些重要安全倡导者的支持，其中包括州长公路安全协会首席执行官Jonathan Adkins。
examples.speechText: Still, they have earned the support of important safety advocates, including Jonathan Adkins, the chief executive officer of the Governors Highway Safety Association.

examples.text: Some valuable metals are often mined（mine的过去分词形式） in extremely poor working conditions.
examples.translation: 一些有价值的金属经常是在极其恶劣的工作条件下开采出来的。
examples.speechText: Some valuable metals are often mined in extremely poor working conditions.

examples.text: Formal training is where the dogs demonstrate whether they will become a guide dog for the blind.
examples.translation: 在正式训练中，犬只会展示自己是否具备成为盲人导盲犬的能力。
examples.speechText: Formal training is where the dogs demonstrate whether they will become a guide dog for the blind.

examples.source: （2014年配套材料·选句填空·完整句选项）

examples.text: Such events（event的复数形式） have encouraged more and more people to become influencers.
examples.translation: 这类活动鼓励了越来越多的人去成为网络红人。
examples.speechText: Such events have encouraged more and more people to become influencers.

examples.text: Canceling plans does not mean a friendship will break.
examples.translation: 取消约定并不意味着友谊会破裂。
examples.speechText: Canceling plans does not mean a friendship will break.

examples.text: The US alone has more than a quarter of a billion phones ready to be recycled and an extra 11 million are added to this figure every month.
examples.translation: 仅美国就有超过2.5亿部手机等待回收，而且这个数字每月还会增加1100万部。
examples.speechText: The US alone has more than a quarter of a billion phones ready to be recycled and an extra 11 million are added to this figure every month.

examples.text: And when phones are buried under the ground, harmful elements leak into the soil, polluting groundwater.
examples.translation: 手机被埋入地下时，其中的有害元素会渗入土壤，污染地下水。
examples.speechText: And when phones are buried under the ground, harmful elements leak into the soil, polluting groundwater.

examples.text: Fundamentally, the more people give, the happier（happy的比较级） they get.
examples.translation: 从根本上说，人们付出得越多，就越快乐。
examples.speechText: Fundamentally, the more people give, the happier they get.

examples.text: Hers was an old family; her ancestors had come to the United States 200 years before.
examples.translation: 她的家族是一个古老的家族；她的祖先早在两百年前就来到了美国。
examples.speechText: Hers was an old family; her ancestors had come to the United States 200 years before.
